research_metadata.target_region: Peninsula Bay Area (San Mateo County and North San Mateo areas)
research_metadata.notes: Automated web fetching restricted in this environment. Use this template to populate with data from authoritative sources listed below.

primary.name: Zillow Market Reports
primary.description: Zillow Home Value Index (ZHVI) historical data, market reports, price trends by city
primary.access_method: Direct web browse, market insights tab

primary.name: Redfin Market Insights
primary.description: Market data, price trends, inventory insights, days on market, median prices by neighborhood

primary.name: Realtor.com Research
primary.description: NAR data, median home prices by metro and city, market reports

primary.name: San Mateo County MLS
primary.description: Official MLS data for San Mateo County with current and historical sales data
primary.access_method: MLS membership or local agent access

primary.name: CoreLogic/DataQuick
primary.description: Historical home price data and market analytics

secondary.name: Bay Area Board of Realtors (BARR)
secondary.description: Monthly and quarterly market reports for Bay Area including Peninsula

secondary.name: San Mateo County Assessor
secondary.description: Property valuations, parcel data, market analysis reports

secondary.name: San Mateo County Recorder
secondary.description: Recorded sales, deed information, historical transaction data

secondary.name: Local Real Estate Agents
secondary.description: Agents often have current market data and recent sales comparables (comps)
secondary.access_method: Email or phone outreach to local agents

secondary.name: LoopNet/CoStar
secondary.description: Commercial and residential property data with transaction details

secondary.name: California Regional MLS Systems
secondary.description: Northern California MLS with historical data for Peninsula region

step1_zillow_approach: Look for the 'Market insights' or 'Zestimate' tab
Note the 'As of' date on the data
Screenshot or copy the median price
step2_redfin_approach: Find median sale price and 3BR median if available
Note the data timestamp (typically updated daily/weekly)
Look for price history graphs to assess recency
step3_mls_approach: Contact local MLS or real estate agent for most current data
Request '3BR, 1700+ sqft median sold price for last 6-12 months'
Get both median price and sample of recent sales
Request market report for the city
step4_county_assessor_approach: Visit San Mateo County Assessor website
Access public assessor data for median valuations
step5_multiple_sources_per_town: Goal: Find 3-5 authoritative sources per town minimum
Average where reasonable, or flag outliers with explanation
Always cite the source with most recent data

quality_criteria.data_recency: Prioritize 2026 data, accept 2025 Q4-2026 Q1 data, mark 2024+ data as 'prior year'

confidence_levels.high: Data from Q2 2026 or later, multiple corroborating sources, MLS or assessor origin
confidence_levels.medium: Q1 2026 data, or single authoritative source, 3+ month age
confidence_levels.low: 2024 data, derived estimates, single non-authoritative source, or >6 months old

price_points_to_verify: Median price should be consistent across 2-3 independent sources (+/- 5%)
If sources diverge by >10%, flag as 'conflicting data' and use range
3BR-specific prices preferred; overall median acceptable if 3BR unavailable
Always note: 'Overall median' vs. '3BR median' vs. 'Price per sqft'

phase1_quick_search: Screenshot median home value for each
Note dates stamped on each page
phase2_redfin_cross_check: Capture median sale price and recent trend data
phase3_mls_validation: Email local real estate agents or MLS contact
Request current 3BR median for each town
Request sold comps from last 30-60 days
phase4_compilation: Populate JSON template with best data from all sources
Mark confidence level for each entry
Calculate average where multiple sources exist
Note any data conflicts in 'notes' field

expected_output_per_town.medianPrice: Numeric price in USD (e.g., 1450000) or null if unable to find
expected_output_per_town.source: Name of data source (e.g., 'Zillow Q2 2026', 'San Mateo MLS April 2026')
expected_output_per_town.url: Direct URL to the data page if available
expected_output_per_town.date: Publication or data collection date (YYYY-MM-DD or 'Q2 2026')
expected_output_per_town.notes: Additional context: '2026 Q2 data, 50 sales in period', 'Conflicting data: Zillow $1.4M vs Redfin $1.5M', 'Based on Zestimate, not actuals', etc.

summary_statistics.notes: To be populated after all towns are researched; useful for assessing market range for $2M buyer

Calculate what $2M budget buys in each town ('What does $2M buy here?')
Integrate into Step 2 neighborhood scoring for Peninsula region (Region 4)
